name: Olympique Lyonnais Groupe Société Anonyme
summary: Olympique Lyonnais Groupe Société Anonyme together with its subsidiaries, operates in the entertainment and media sector in France. The company manages Olympique Lyonnais football club and operates Groupama stadium. It also distributes and markets derivative products under the Olympique Lyonnais brand; and produces television programs for institutional, advertising, event-related, or documentary films. In addition, the company is involved in ticketing office, marketing and tv rights, partnerships and advertising, brand products, events, and player trading businesses.
